html:
My best grokbot use case yet.

I told it to build a chrome extension that shames me when on procrastinate on social media.

Now, when I go to X or Linkedin, it bricks my screen & I have to record a video of me saying "I'm being a bad, bad boy" to unlock the app.

It one-shotted… pic.twitter.com/q9fKWfH8Lw

— Alex Lieberman (@businessbarista) August 20, 2026
